summary: Frontend-only testing of BidBlitz V2 new features: Support Center (Help Page) and Activity Feed. All tests passed. Both features are accessible from More page menu, fully functional with proper i18n translations (German), and have consistent dark mode design.
passed_tests: Login with customer credentials (kunde@bidblitz.com / Kunde2026!) - SUCCESS
Navigate to More page via nav-more-btn - SUCCESS
More page displays menu-help-btn (Help & Support) - SUCCESS
More page displays menu-activity-btn (Activity) - SUCCESS
SUPPORT PAGE: Click Help & Support opens SupportPage with data-testid='support-page' - SUCCESS
SUPPORT PAGE: Hero card displayed with title 'Wie können wir helfen?' - SUCCESS
SUPPORT PAGE: Search input (support-search-input) found and functional - SUCCESS
SUPPORT PAGE: All 4 category chips found (support-cat-payments, support-cat-account, support-cat-security, support-cat-merchant) - SUCCESS
SUPPORT PAGE: Search filtering works - searching 'Passwort' filters from 12 FAQs to 3 - SUCCESS
SUPPORT PAGE: Category chip filtering works - clicking Payments shows exactly 3 FAQs - SUCCESS
SUPPORT PAGE: FAQ accordion expand/collapse works (faq-toggle-* selectors) - SUCCESS
SUPPORT PAGE: Contact form elements found (support-subject-input, support-message-input, support-send-btn) - SUCCESS
SUPPORT PAGE: Contact form submission shows 'Nachricht gesendet!' (sent state) - SUCCESS
SUPPORT PAGE: Back button (support-back-btn) navigates to More page - SUCCESS
ACTIVITY PAGE: Click Activity opens ActivityPage with data-testid='activity-page' - SUCCESS
ACTIVITY PAGE: Stats bar (activity-stats) displayed with Income/Spent/Transactions - SUCCESS
ACTIVITY PAGE: All 5 filter chips found (activity-filter-all, topup, payment, send, receive) - SUCCESS
ACTIVITY PAGE: 29 transaction items displayed - SUCCESS
ACTIVITY PAGE: Filter 'Top-ups' shows empty state (no top-ups for this user) - SUCCESS
ACTIVITY PAGE: Filter 'Payments' shows 28 items - SUCCESS
ACTIVITY PAGE: Filter 'Sent' shows 1 item - SUCCESS
ACTIVITY PAGE: Filter 'Received' shows empty state - SUCCESS
ACTIVITY PAGE: Refresh button (activity-refresh-btn) works - SUCCESS
ACTIVITY PAGE: Back button (activity-back-btn) navigates to More page - SUCCESS
I18N: All text properly translated to German (Hilfe & Support, Aktivität, Zahlungen, etc.) - SUCCESS
DESIGN: Dark mode aesthetic consistent, good contrast, proper spacing - SUCCESS
context_for_next_testing_agent: Support Center and Activity Feed features fully tested and working. SupportPage accessible via menu-help-btn on MorePage, has search filtering, category chips (payments/account/security/merchant), FAQ accordions, and MOCKED contact form (frontend-only, no backend endpoint). ActivityPage accessible via menu-activity-btn, calls GET /api/transactions, displays stats bar, filter chips, and transaction list. Both pages have proper i18n translations for 12 languages. All data-testid attributes are correctly implemented.

mocked_apis.support_contact_form: Frontend-only - shows 'sent' animation but no actual POST to backend
